field_definitions.actions[]: Per-finding fix and suppression suggestions. Each entry carries a `type` discriminant (kebab-case) plus a per-action `auto_fixable` bool. Consumers dispatch on `type` to choose the remediation and filter on `auto_fixable` of each individual entry.
field_definitions.actions[].auto_fixable: Evaluated PER FINDING, not per action type. The same `type` may carry `auto_fixable: true` on one finding and `auto_fixable: false` on another when per-instance guards in the `fallow fix` applier discriminate. Filter on this bool of each individual action, not on `type` alone. Current per-instance flips: (1) `remove-catalog-entry` is `true` only when the finding's `hardcoded_consumers` array is empty (else fallow fix skips the entry to avoid breaking `pnpm install`); (2) the primary dependency action flips between `remove-dependency` (`auto_fixable: true`) and `move-dependency` (`auto_fixable: false`) based on `used_in_workspaces`; (3) `add-to-config` for `ignoreExports` is `true` when fallow fix can safely apply the action, which means EITHER a fallow config file already exists OR no config exists and the working directory is NOT inside a monorepo subpackage (the applier then creates `.fallowrc.json` using `fallow init`'s framework-aware scaffolding and layers the new rules on top); `false` inside a monorepo subpackage with no workspace-root config because the applier refuses to fragment per-package configs; (4) `update-catalog-reference` is always `false` today (catalog-switching applier not yet wired). All `suppress-line` and `suppress-file` actions are uniformly `false`.

avg_cyclomatic.name: Average Cyclomatic Complexity
avg_cyclomatic.description: Mean over authored function, module-scope, and template units before finding filters. Divide the sum of cyclomatic_population group sums by the sum of their counts, rounded to one decimal.
avg_cyclomatic.interpretation: zero for an empty population; lower is better

bus_factor.name: Bus Factor
bus_factor.description: Minimum number of contributors who account for most recent weighted commits.

cognitive.name: Cognitive Complexity
cognitive.description: Cognitive complexity penalizes nesting depth and non-linear control flow.

complexity_density.name: Complexity Density
complexity_density.description: Total cyclomatic complexity divided by lines of code.
complexity_density.interpretation: lower is better; >1.0 indicates very dense complexity

confidence.name: Confidence Level
confidence.description: Reliability of the recommendation based on data source.
confidence.interpretation: high means act on it; medium or low means verify context

contributor_count.name: Contributor Count
contributor_count.description: Number of distinct authors who touched this file in the analysis window.
contributor_count.interpretation: higher generally indicates broader knowledge spread

crap_max.name: Untested Complexity Risk (CRAP)
crap_max.description: Highest Change Risk Anti-Patterns score from complexity and coverage evidence.
crap_max.interpretation: lower is better; high values indicate complex untested code

critical_complexity_pct.name: Critical Cyclomatic Share
critical_complexity_pct.description: Percentage of the cyclomatic unit population at or above the critical threshold, including module scopes and templates.
critical_complexity_pct.interpretation: absent for an empty population; lower is better

css_analytics.summary.near_duplicate_css.name: Near-Duplicate CSS-in-JS Tokens
css_analytics.summary.near_duplicate_css.description: Count of CSS-in-JS design tokens whose comparable values are close to another project token. Present only in deep CSS analysis.
css_analytics.summary.near_duplicate_css.interpretation: 0 means no near-duplicate CSS-in-JS token candidates were found

css_analytics.summary.near_duplicate_the.name: Near-Duplicate Theme Tokens
css_analytics.summary.near_duplicate_the.description: Count of Tailwind v4 theme tokens whose comparable values are close to another token in the same theme dictionary. Present only in deep CSS analysis.
css_analytics.summary.near_duplicate_the.interpretation: 0 means no near-duplicate token candidates were found

cyclomatic.name: Cyclomatic Complexity
cyclomatic.description: McCabe cyclomatic complexity: 1 + number of decision points.

cyclomatic_population.count.name: Cyclomatic Population Count
cyclomatic_population.count.description: Unit count in each disjoint functions, modules, or templates group. Modules contribute to aggregate metrics without producing function findings.
cyclomatic_population.count.interpretation: sum the three counts to obtain the distribution denominator

cyclomatic_population.max.name: Cyclomatic Population Maximum
cyclomatic_population.max.description: Highest cyclomatic value within each functions, modules, or templates group; null when that group has no units.
cyclomatic_population.max.interpretation: identifies which kind of unit drives the tail; module units remain aggregate-only

cyclomatic_population.sum.name: Cyclomatic Population Sum
cyclomatic_population.sum.description: Sum of cyclomatic values in each functions, modules, or templates group before rounding and threshold filtering.
cyclomatic_population.sum.interpretation: sum the three groups to obtain the mean numerator

dead_code_ratio.name: Dead Code Ratio
dead_code_ratio.description: Fraction of value exports with zero references across the project.
dead_code_ratio.interpretation: lower is better; 0 means all exports are used

degree.name: Change Coupling Degree
degree.description: Shared commits of two files divided by the mean commit count of the two files.
degree.interpretation: higher means the two files change together more often; a hidden pair has no import between the files

drift.name: Ownership Drift
drift.description: Whether original authorship and current contribution ownership have diverged.
drift.interpretation: true means current review ownership may differ from original ownership

effort.name: Effort Estimate
effort.description: Heuristic effort estimate based on file size, function count, and fan-in.
effort.interpretation: low means quick win, high needs planning and coordination

fan_in.name: Fan-in (Importers)
fan_in.description: Number of files that import this file.
fan_in.interpretation: context-dependent; high fan-in files need careful review

fan_out.name: Fan-out (Imports)
fan_out.description: Number of files this file directly imports.
fan_out.interpretation: lower is better; high fan-out indicates coupling

health_score.name: Health Score
health_score.description: Project-level aggregate score computed from vital signs and issue signals.
health_score.interpretation: higher is better; missing metrics are not penalized

health_score.formula_version.name: Health Score Formula Version
health_score.formula_version.description: Version of the health-scoring rubric used to produce the current score.
health_score.formula_version.interpretation: compare score values only when both formula versions are known and equal

health_trend.compared_to.score_formula_v.name: Baseline Health Score Formula Version
health_trend.compared_to.score_formula_v.description: Formula version saved with the historical score; absent on legacy or unscored snapshots.
health_trend.compared_to.score_formula_v.interpretation: the score delta is omitted when formula versions are unknown or different; available raw metric trends remain comparable

inner_iterations_per_call.name: Inner Iterations per Call
inner_iterations_per_call.description: Peak executions of one block inside a hot function per call, from V8 block coverage.
inner_iterations_per_call.interpretation: 1.0 means no block ran more than once per call; 3.0 means a loop body ran 3 times per call. Calls to other functions do not change the value

line_count.name: Function Line Count
line_count.description: Number of lines in the function body.
line_count.interpretation: context-dependent; long functions may need splitting

lines.name: File Line Count
lines.description: Total lines of code in the file.
lines.interpretation: context-dependent; large files may benefit from splitting

maintainability_index.name: Maintainability Index
maintainability_index.description: Composite file score combining complexity density, dead code ratio, and coupling.

max_render_fan_in.name: Render Fan-in (Blast Radius)
max_render_fan_in.description: Highest distinct-parent render count across React or Preact components.
max_render_fan_in.interpretation: descriptive only; high values mean broad edit ripple

median_files_per_commit.name: Change Dispersion (Files)
median_files_per_commit.description: Median number of analyzed files in the commits that changed this file. Bulk commits above the change coupling file cap are not counted.
median_files_per_commit.interpretation: higher means a change to this file usually spreads over more files

median_lines_per_commit.name: Change Dispersion (Lines)
median_lines_per_commit.description: Median number of added plus deleted lines, analyzed files only, in the commits that changed this file.
median_lines_per_commit.interpretation: higher means a change to this file is usually large

optimization_cost_score.name: Optimization Cost Score
optimization_cost_score.description: Invocations multiplied by the per-call cost, on runtime_coverage.hot_paths[].optimization_target. The per-call cost is the peak block executions per call from V8 block coverage (cost_basis inner_iterations), or static cognitive complexity with a minimum of 1 when the function has no usable block counts (cost_basis cognitive).
optimization_cost_score.interpretation: higher means a larger speed gain; compare it only between hot paths with the same cost_basis. importance ranks the risk of a change, not the speed gain

p90_cyclomatic.name: P90 Cyclomatic Complexity
p90_cyclomatic.description: Nearest-rank 90th percentile over the same units as avg_cyclomatic, including module scopes and templates.
p90_cyclomatic.interpretation: zero for an empty population; lower is better

percent_dead_in_production.name: Percent Dead in Production
percent_dead_in_production.description: Fraction of tracked functions with zero observed invocations, multiplied by 100.

priority.name: Refactoring Priority
priority.description: Weighted refactoring score using complexity, hotspots, dead code, fan-in, and fan-out.
priority.interpretation: higher means more urgent to refactor

production_invocations.name: Production Invocations
production_invocations.description: Observed invocation count for the function over the collected coverage window.
production_invocations.interpretation: 0 plus tracked means cold path; high means active path

runtime_coverage_confidence.name: Runtime Coverage Confidence
runtime_coverage_confidence.interpretation: high means act on it; medium or low means verify context

runtime_coverage_state.name: Runtime Coverage State
runtime_coverage_state.interpretation: never-called with static unused is the highest-confidence delete signal

runtime_coverage_verdict.name: Runtime Coverage Verdict
runtime_coverage_verdict.interpretation: cold-code-detected is the primary standalone cleanup signal

score.name: Hotspot Score
score.description: Normalized churn multiplied by normalized complexity.
score.interpretation: higher means riskier; prioritize refactoring high-score files

share.name: Contributor Share
share.description: Recency-weighted share of total weighted commits attributed to a contributor.
share.interpretation: share close to 1.0 indicates ownership concentration

stale_days.name: Stale Days
stale_days.description: Days since this contributor last touched the file.
stale_days.interpretation: high stale days can indicate ownership drift

styling_findings[].blast_radius.name: Styling Finding Blast Radius
styling_findings[].blast_radius.description: Static lower-bound count of known consumers affected by a styling finding. Omitted when the family has no reliable blast-radius model.
styling_findings[].blast_radius.interpretation: 0 means no static consumers were found; omitted means unknown

styling_findings[].nearest_token.distanc.name: Nearest Styling Token Distance
styling_findings[].nearest_token.distanc.description: Distance between a token-drift finding and its nearest comparable token. Units depend on the token namespace.
styling_findings[].nearest_token.distanc.interpretation: lower means closer; compare only within the same token namespace

styling_health.formula_version.name: Styling Health Formula Version
styling_health.formula_version.description: Version of the styling-health scoring rubric used to produce the score. Present only under --css.
styling_health.formula_version.interpretation: bump signals a rubric change; compare scores only within the same version

styling_health.penalties.broken_referenc.name: Styling Broken-References Penalty
styling_health.penalties.broken_referenc.description: Points deducted for markup classes one edit from a defined class and animations referencing undefined keyframes. Present only under --css.
styling_health.penalties.broken_referenc.interpretation: lower is better; 0 means no broken references

styling_health.penalties.dead_surface.name: Styling Dead-Surface Penalty
styling_health.penalties.dead_surface.description: Points deducted for unreferenced classes, unused tokens, at-rules, and font-faces, normalized per stylesheet. Present only under --css.
styling_health.penalties.dead_surface.interpretation: lower is better; 0 means no dead styling surface

styling_health.penalties.duplication.name: Styling Duplication Penalty
styling_health.penalties.duplication.description: Points deducted for copy-paste declaration blocks, scaled by the share of declarations removable via consolidation. Present only under --css.
styling_health.penalties.duplication.interpretation: lower is better; 0 means no removable duplicate blocks

styling_health.penalties.structural.name: Styling Structural Penalty
styling_health.penalties.structural.description: Points deducted for !important density above a healthy floor and deep style-rule nesting. Present only under --css.
styling_health.penalties.structural.interpretation: lower is better; 0 means no structural smells

styling_health.penalties.token_erosion.name: Styling Token-Erosion Penalty
styling_health.penalties.token_erosion.description: Points deducted for mixing font-size units past a healthy baseline and Tailwind arbitrary-value bypasses. Present only under --css.
styling_health.penalties.token_erosion.interpretation: lower is better; 0 means a single source of truth for the scale

styling_health.score.name: Styling Health Score
styling_health.score.description: CSS/styling-axis aggregate score computed from the styling penalty rubric. Present only under --css.
styling_health.score.interpretation: higher is better; missing metrics are not penalized

trend.name: Churn Trend
trend.description: Compares recent vs older commit frequency within the analysis window.
trend.interpretation: accelerating files need attention; cooling files are stabilizing

unowned.name: Unowned (Tristate)
unowned.description: Whether CODEOWNERS exists but has no matching owner for this file.
unowned.interpretation: true on a hotspot is a review-bottleneck risk

weighted_commits.name: Weighted Commits
weighted_commits.description: Recency-weighted commit count using exponential decay.
weighted_commits.interpretation: higher means more recent churn activity
